title: Reconcile application exports and deliver a reproducible result
prompt: Use the supplied public records to reconcile totals, investigate differences and produce the declared evidence. Select suitable computer tools and independently test the result. This example is a template, not a profession restriction.

outputs.name: result.json
outputs.requirement: An inspectable result and the method used to establish it.

criteria.requirement: The result satisfies the requested reconciliation.
criteria.verification: Recompute from the original inputs and inspect any unexplained differences.

settlement.recovery: Use the manager cancellation, dispute and expiry paths; preserve claims and reservation journals.
